issue.title: Clippy redundant_closure in records CLI blocks just lint
issue.description: ## CI failure - **Node:** just lint (cargo clippy redundant_closure at src/native/records/cli.rs:112) Fails deterministically on base 3e68a53a; file untouched by gmail work.

task_type_fields.why_not_flake: Deterministic clippy -D failure on the base tree; gmail changes touch only gmail/sync, docs, tests (git status proof); reruns fail identically.

issue.creation_reason: just lint fails on the unchanged base tree at src/native/records/cli.rs:112, blocking verification of the gmail health landing

payload.entry: Resolved within the Record Notes epic (bob-cli-ir, which caused it via ir.3 records CLI). bob-cli-ir.land reran just check on master 0a74731b: cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets --all-features with the project gate (-D clippy::redundant_closure) passed with no denied findings; src/native/records/cli.rs no longer has the closure at :112. Remaining just check failures on that tree are the four notebooks lib tests from j8.1, unrelated.
